notes: «المعنى الواحد» is an editor's gloss and is left out
«يحدثان عن النعمان بن بشير» : Hamid and Muhammad both narrate from Nu'man, so they stand as one level under Zuhri
«أن أباه، نحل ابنا له» is the story told in the saying: the father is in the scene, not a link; the compiler's remarks are left out
